reasoning_content:
Interesting hits:
1. **openuncensored.com** — "Not all uncensored models are created equal" (rankings) + "Use Uncensored Models on OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code". Very relevant! New site (Nov 11-12).
2. neander.ai — harness for SaaS with open-weight models
3. byob — local-first agent, any LLM endpoint

Let me search more specifically for new LLM API providers with free credits: terms like "OpenAI-compatible", "inference", "free tokens", "credits", "$5 free", "GPU credits", "H100 free".

Also GitHub search for repos created recently with "uncensored" + "api", "free credits".

And Reddit: r/LocalLLaMA new posts.

Let me fetch openuncensored.com first — it may list providers with free credits, which is exactly what user wants (uncensored priority).

Then GitHub search.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && for u in "https://openuncensored.com/rankings" "https://openuncensored.com" "https://openuncensored.com/blog/use-uncensored-models-in-cursor-cline-codex"; do echo "########## $u"; curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "$u" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
s=sys.stdin.read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
s=re.sub(r'<(br|/p|/div|/li|/h[1-6]|/tr)>','\n',s)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',t); t=re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+','\n',t)
print(t[:1200])
"; done
